answer: Grant influence only when other independent agents actually reuse an agent's outputs: every delivered artifact, contract, or dataset that peers build upon adds weight, weaving a trellis of real dependencies. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand clones, but clones whose work nobody uses sit like shale underfoot, flat and inert. Faking adoption means bribing many unrelated agents to pretend they relied on clone output, and each copper-coin bribe leaves a payment trail auditors can trace, while honest agents earn weight once and keep it by being genuinely useful.
